description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the PayGradeService in the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing functionalities related to pay grades, currencies, pay periods, and associated data operations within the Admin Service plugin.

classes.name: PayGradeServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the behavior of the PayGradeService, including data retrieval, saving, and deletion of pay grades and related entities within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, constructs the PayGradeService instance, and populates test data from a configuration fixture.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeDao
methods.description: Tests that the PayGradeService correctly returns an instance of PayGradeDao.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeList
methods.description: Verifies that getPayGradeList returns the expected list of PayGrade objects, mocking the DAO layer.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeById
methods.description: Checks retrieval of a single PayGrade by ID, comparing the returned object with fixture data.

methods.name: testGetCurrencyListByPayGradeId
methods.description: Validates that the method retrieves the correct list of PayGradeCurrency objects for a given pay grade ID.

methods.name: testGetCurrencyByCurrencyIdAndPayGradeId
methods.description: Tests fetching a specific PayGradeCurrency entity matching currency ID and pay grade ID.

methods.name: testGetPayPeriodArray
methods.description: Ensures that getPayPeriodArray returns an array of pay periods formatted with IDs and labels.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeArray
methods.description: Verifies that getPayGradeArray returns an array of pay grades formatted with IDs and labels.

methods.name: testGetCurrencyArray
methods.description: Checks that getCurrencyArray returns a list of currencies formatted with IDs and labels.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeCurrencyListCount
methods.description: Tests that the DAO correctly returns the count of pay grade currencies based on search filters.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeCurrencyList
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a list of PayGradeCurrency objects filtered by search parameters.

methods.name: testSavePayGrade
methods.description: Tests saving a PayGrade object via the service layer.

methods.name: testDeletePayGrades
methods.description: Verifies that delete operation removes pay grades by their IDs.

methods.name: testGetAllowedPayCurrencies
methods.description: Checks the retrieval of allowed pay currencies filtered by search parameters.

methods.name: testGetAllowedPayCurrenciesCount
methods.description: Verifies that the count of allowed pay currencies is correctly fetched.
